resolution.note: missing tier defaults to finish; regression test at the parser

title: A standards record adopted before tiers parses as a finish standard
body:
Why: #777 made tier a required standards field; an adopted repository whose .agents/standards.json predates tiers is refused with exit 65 and every krn lane run there stops (.krn/runs/units-ts/lanes/self-link.log).
Outcome: a record without a tier parses as a finish standard.
Proof: test/brain/standards.test.ts PASS; npm run fast PASS.
